name: Nakata Shuuichi
source:
Miho's only son. He is a virgin. He joined the station as an assistant director this spring as a new graduate hire.

He is a capable person, but as a new assistant director, he is always making mistakes. However, he tries his best to work as long as he can work at the same place as his mother.

Perhaps because of his strong feelings for his mother, he has a taste for mature women and has no interest in girls his own age.
